OECD Consumption Tax Trends: key findings for Iceland (24% standard and 11% reduced since 2015)

caveats: Rates primary from Skatturinn's VAT page (24% and 11%, retrieved 2026-11-13); the page does not state effective dates, so from records the retrieval date.
individualTaxYear is the calendar year, inferred from the country's annual assessment cycle (grade I); not confirmed on the authority's own pages in this pass.
companyYearEndDefault is a 31 December app default for new entities (grade I), not a statutory requirement; companies may choose other year ends under national law.

Both rates have applied since 1 January 2015 (standard cut from 25.5%, reduced raised from 7%); a legislated cut to 22.5% planned for 2019 was never brought into force. Fuel was temporarily moved to the 11% reduced rate from 1 May to 31 August 2026 - a scope carve-out, not a rate change.
